description: FREE (key) — Use to read, filter or count the records of a ListPlus list. read records of a list shared with you: `mode` rows (default; columns you may see, each with id and url), count, or ids (up to 10,000, to pass on as record_ids). Filter by column values or conditions (describe_list names them).

columns.description: Only these columns in the rows

filter.description: Column → value: exact, { "contains": "…" }, { "not": "…" }, { "is_empty": true } or { "condition": "<one of filter_conditions>" }; ar_status by status name

include_hidden.description: Also records hidden in the list (status "ignored")

limit.description: Rows per call (capped by the list's share, default 100)

list_id.description: The list's id (describe_list without list_id shows the lists shared with you)

logic.description: How several filter entries combine (default and)

name: query_records
title: Query records
